notes.bigquery: jobs.query runs any SQL, including DML and DDL, so it is classified write. Its tool is registered only when GSM_ALLOW_WRITES=true. Check the statement before running it.
notes.indexing: Only for pages with JobPosting or BroadcastEvent (inside VideoObject) structured data. Google restricts this API to those page types.
notes.secretmanager: versions.access returns the secret payload in clear text. Treat the output as a credential.
notes.tagmanager: versions.publish makes a container version live, which changes tags on live sites.
notes.script: scripts.run executes Apps Script code with the project's authority, so it is classified destructive.
notes.compute: Methods that remove, detach, stop or suspend resources are classified write unless listed as destructive. Check the effect first.
notes.cloudidentity: devices.wipe factory-resets the device and is destructive.
notes.sqladmin: instances.export writes a dump file to Cloud Storage. It is classified write.
notes.googleads: Every mutate method is dynamic, so the risk is decided per call from the body. validateOnly true is a read and is not gated; a remove operation is destructive; any other operation is a write. The rule is the same in the per-method tools, the gateway and the hook (src/core/dynamic.ts).
